info.title: DuckDuckGo Search
info.description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo. Returns JSON formatted search results. Use this tool to search for real-time information, news, and current events.

get.description: Search the web for current information. Use this to find real-time news, facts, and data. IMPORTANT: Always include o=json and api=d.js parameters.

parameters.name: o
parameters.description: Output format. MUST be set to 'json'

parameters.name: api
parameters.description: API type. MUST be set to 'd.js'
